_comment: Test material, designs, and evaluation rules, frozen before any system code was written. account.json, help_center.json and prompt.json are byte-identical copies of 04-agent-memory/data (same SHA-256 as its FROZEN.json). python/tools.py and python/llm.py were copied byte-identical from 04-agent-memory/python before the freeze; they are shared code, not part of the designs. python/run.py checks these hashes before every run and records them in the results.
